thought.text: All 8 OGC endpoints are live. Now verify the web apps and REST APIs:

reasoning_content:
All 8 OGC service endpoints documented in the guide return HTTP 200 with complete Capabilities. Next, I'll verify the web apps and APIs:
- XPlanManagerWeb (8081 → proxy /xplan-manager-web)
- XPlanValidatorWeb
- ROOT web page
- XPlanManagerAPI (18082 → /xplan-manager-api) — probably the Swagger UI
- XPlanValidatorAPI
- XPlanDokumenteAPI

Let's check the status of these deployments and their endpoints.

action.command:
echo "=== anwendung deployments ==="; grep -E "Deployment of web (application archive|application directory) .* has finished|startup failed|SEVERE" /opt/tomcat-anwendung/logs/catalina.out | sed 's/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m//g' | grep -E "1[01]:(3[5-9]|4[0-9])" | tail -8
echo "=== api deployments ==="; grep -E "Deployment of web application archive .* has finished|Error deploying" /opt/tomcat-api/logs/catalina.out | sed 's/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m//g' | grep -E "1[01]:(3[5-9]|4[0-9])" | tail -5
